content.comment_body: Hello, I'm monitoring the temperature sensor for a buffer tank holding water, which is heated using solar energy. I need to track the highest temperature value each day and have it reset at midnight. I set up a weekly timer to generate a pulse output, and I can view the values in the web interface, but the max value does not reset as expected. During simulation everything works, but in actual operation it fails to reset. Can anyone assist? Thank you!
Please upload your [product_name] program along with your web editor project in a ZIP file.
Hello, I've resolved the issue. The problem was with the internal clock configuration.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced a discrepancy between simulation and real-time system performance, where the daily maximum temperature did not reset at midnight in actual use. This was traced to an incorrectly configured internal clock, which did not affect simulation but led to issues in the real setup. The case highlights the importance of proper system configuration, especially for time-dependent features, to achieve reliable operation outside of simulated environments.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the system to consistently reset the max temperature value at midnight in both simulation and real-world operation, seeking reliable and uniform behavior across all usage modes.
